slides.title: Tax-free shopping just changed
slides.sub: 5 things to know before you shop

slides.title: You pay full price at the store
body: The 10% consumption tax is no longer removed at the register.
You get it back later as a [[refund]].

slides.title: Claim it at the airport
body: On your way home, go to [[customs before check-in]].
Show your passport and the items you bought.
slides.note: Pack tax-free items where you can reach them.

slides.title: Don't open the snacks
body: Snacks, drinks and cosmetics must stay [[unused]] until you leave Japan, or you lose the refund for them.

slides.title: Still ¥5,000 per store
body: Spend at least [[¥5,000 before tax]] at the same store on the same day.
slides.note: Good news: no more sealed tax-free bags.

slides.title: Used the e-gates on arrival?
body: Ask an officer for a [[passport entry stamp]] right after.
And leave extra time at the airport: expect queues.
